dosageInstruction[0].doseAndRate[0].description: The dose of the medication to be taken
dosageInstruction[0].doseAndRate[0].value:
- dose[x] (0..1): Amount of medication per dose. One of these 2:
  - doseRange : {
      "low" : { // Low limit
        "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
        "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
        "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
        "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
      },
      "high" : { // High limit
        "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
        "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
        "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
        "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
      }
    }
  - doseQuantity : { Quantity(SimpleQuantity) }
- rate[x] (0..1): Amount of medication per unit of time. One of these 3:
  - rateRatio: {
      "numerator" : { // Numerator value
          "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
          "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
          "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
          "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
        },
      "denominator" : { // Denominator value
          "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
          "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
          "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
          "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
        }
    }
  - rateRange: {
      "low" : { // Low limit
          "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
          "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
          "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
          "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
        },
      "high" : { // High limit
          "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
          "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
          "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
          "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
        }
    }
  - rateQuantity: {
      "value" : Decimal, // The value that express the quantity
      "unit" : String, // The unit of measure
      "system" : "http://unitsofmeasure.org",
      "code" : String // The code for the unit of measure
    }

priority.description: Characterizes how quickly the proposed act must be initiated. Accepted values are: routine, urgent, asap, stat.

value.title: Urgent
value.description: The request should be actioned promptly - higher priority than routine.

value.title: ASAP
value.description: The request should be actioned as soon as possible - higher priority than urgent.

value.title: STAT
value.description: The request should be actioned immediately - highest possible priority. E.g. an emergency.

payload[0].contentAttachment.description: The content to be communicated to the recipient
payload[0].contentAttachment.value:
- contentType (0..1): "<code>", // Mime type of the content, with charset etc.
- "language" (0..1): "<code>", // Human language of the content (BCP-47)
- "data" (0..1): "<base64Binary>", // Data inline, base64ed
- "url" (0..1): "<url>", // Uri where the data can be found
- "title" (0..1): "<string>", // Label to display in place of the data

requester.description: The device, individual, or organization who asks for the information to be shared.

recipient[].description: The list of entities (e.g. person, organization, clinical information system, device, group, or care team) which is the intended target of the communication.

informationProvider[].description: The list of entities (e.g. person, organization, clinical information system, or device) which is to be the source of the communication.
